plan.analysis: I choose N=4 because the supplied kernel exposes four distinct avenues: block-local reuse of source particles, register reuse across multiple outputs per thread, parallelizing the source-reduction dimension, and reducing per-interaction arithmetic. Each tree should focus on its named mechanism; each may tune its own launch configuration, avoiding a redundant launch-only tree. The source has an O(n²) interaction loop and no shared-memory staging. The supplied baseline is valid: three measured repetitions were 1.8502648, 1.8501167, and 1.8501610 ms (mean 1.8501808 ms); no candidate comparison is available yet. Judge candidates by the official geometric-mean CUDA-event time and preserve the required interface, correctness checks, and resource limits. The CUDA 12.6.3 Programming Guide documents block-level shared-memory cooperation and reciprocal-square-root behavior; those are technical context, not evidence of performance on this kernel.
